blocks.text: Bias (janibdari, yaani ek taraf jhukao) samajhne ka matlab hai yeh pehchanna ke har source ka koi khaas viewpoint (nuqta-e-nazar) ya agenda (maqsad) ho sakta hai. Misal: Jo news website kisi masle ki sirf ek taraf ki khabar de, woh biased ho sakti hai. Zaroori hai ke kai nuqta-e-nazar dekhein aur check karein ke maloomat insaf se pesh ki gayi hai ya nahi.

blocks.title: Tidbits (kaam ki baat)
blocks.text: Ehtiyat karein! Unverified (ghair tasdeeq shuda) sources par bharosa karna ya maloomat ki credibility check na karna misinformation (ghalat maloomat) phailane aur kamzor faislon ki wajah ban sakta hai. Gumrah hone se bachne ke liye hamesha maloomat ka origin (asal source) tasdeeq karein, author ki qabiliyat (credentials) check karein, aur bias ya sansani khezi ki nishaniyon par nazar rakhein.

blocks.prompt: MCQ 7: Maloomat parakhte waqt bias samajhna kyun zaroori hai?
blocks.explanation: (b) Source ke viewpoint ya agenda ko pehchan kar us ka hisab rakhne ke liye.

items: Bias: har source ka koi nuqta-e-nazar ya agenda ho sakta hai; kai nuqta-e-nazar dekhein.
Tidbits: origin tasdeeq karein, author check karein, bias aur sansani se bachein.
